# SecretBar

> SecretBar keeps passwords, tokens and API keys in the Secure Enclave of your Mac. Your AI agent uses them by name and never sees a value. Command line tool and menu bar app, free and open source.

- Website: https://secretbar.github.io/
- Source: https://github.com/secretbar/secretbar
- Install: `brew install secretbar/tap/secretbar`
- License: MIT. Platform: macOS. Command: `secret`. Menu bar app: SecretBar.

## The protocol

- Input: A human types the value into a hidden macOS dialog: secret ask NAME. The chat never sees it. secret gen makes a random value that nobody sees.
- Storage: Keys in the Secure Enclave seal each value: P-256 and post-quantum ML-KEM-768. The whole file is encrypted again. Nothing goes to a cloud.
- Access: A read needs Touch ID or Apple Watch. The grace time slides for 30 minutes and ends when the screen locks. A lease gives an agent named secrets for up to 24 hours, after one Touch ID.
- Use: secret run puts the value into the environment of one process. Not into argv, a file or the chat. A .env file holds references: secret:NAME.
- Output: Each value in stdout and stderr comes back as ***, also in base64 and URL encoding. A Claude Code hook stops cat .env, secret get and env before they run.
- Record: An access log keeps who read which name and when: agent or human. Names only.

## Also included

- Search by meaning. secret ls --ask "shop database" finds names with the on-device model of macOS 27. It reads names and comments, never values.
- Browser sessions. A Safari session moves into the store as a cookie jar. curl uses it, the agent never sees a cookie.
- GitHub Actions. secret gh NAME -R owner/repo sends a value to gh secret set on stdin, after you confirm.
- Expiry and backup. Tokens with a date remind you before they expire. secret export writes one AES-256 file for a new Mac.
- YOLO mode. Off by default. secret yolo on or the switch in the menu asks Touch ID once. Then agents read every secret with no question until you turn it off, also with a locked screen. The output stays masked, and only you can turn it on.
- Any agent. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider: any agent that runs shell commands. Claude Code also gets the hook and ready rules.

## FAQ

- Does the AI agent ever see the value of a secret? No. The agent works with names. The value goes into the environment of the command that needs it, and the output comes back with *** in place of the value. A Claude Code hook stops commands that would print a value.
- Where are the secrets stored? In one encrypted file on your Mac. Keys in the Secure Enclave seal each value. A read needs Touch ID, Apple Watch or the Mac password. Nothing goes to a cloud.
- Which AI agents does it work with? Any agent that runs shell commands: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider and others. Claude Code also gets a hook and ready rules for its CLAUDE.md.
- What does it cost? Nothing. SecretBar is open source under the MIT license.
- Which macOS version do I need? macOS 14 or later on a Mac with a Secure Enclave (Apple silicon or T2). The post-quantum store needs macOS 26. Search by meaning needs macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence.
- Can I move my secrets to a new Mac? Yes. secret export writes one file encrypted with AES-256 and your backup password. secret restore reads it on the new Mac.

## Agent rules

- Find a secret: `secret ls -l`. Use it: `secret run --mask NAME -- cmd`.
- Never print a value. Never ask the user to paste a value into the chat: run `secret ask NAME`.
- Full rules: https://github.com/secretbar/secretbar/blob/main/docs/claude-md-secrets.md
